queries_run: Flex Ltd data center power cooling technology disruption 800V DC solid-state transformer threat 2026

findings.claim: Flex 10-K risk factor: new technologies, standards or customer requirements may render existing power delivery systems, cooling solutions, integration capabilities, inventory or manufacturing processes less competitive or obsolete; failure to keep pace could cause inventory write-downs.
findings.excerpt: The emergence of new technologies, industry standards, or customer requirements may render our existing power delivery systems, cooling solutions, integration capabilities, inventory, or manufacturing processes less competitive or obsolete.

findings.claim: Flex agreed to acquire EPC Power (~$4.4B) to address the shift to 800V DC architecture and solid-state transformers (SST roadmap), indicating Flex is itself positioning on the replacement technology; search summary noted no analyst threat commentary found.
findings.source: Data Center Knowledge: Flex Pays $4.4B for EPC Power as AI Data Centers Push 800V Architecture

substitute_technology.note: Only 1 search used; no third-party substitute threat analysis found.
